title: Which Dragon Ball character are you? Free quiz — cv.cm
description: Free Dragon Ball character quiz: answer 12 questions to find out if you're Goku, Vegeta, Gohan, Piccolo, Bulma, Krillin, Trunks or Frieza. Unofficial fan quiz, no sign-up.
h1: Which Dragon Ball character are you?
lede: Always hungry for a stronger opponent like Goku, proud like Vegeta or brilliant like Bulma? Answer 12 questions about training, rivals and friends to find your Dragon Ball match.
about: Akira Toriyama's Dragon Ball, which began as a manga in 1984, is one of the most influential anime and manga series ever made. Its characters are as famous as its fights: cheerful, food-loving Goku; Vegeta, the proud Saiyan prince who refuses to come second; Gohan, Goku's gentle son with huge hidden power; Piccolo, the stern, serious fighter in the white cape; Bulma, the genius inventor who starts the whole adventure; Krillin, Goku's loyal best friend; Trunks, the serious young swordsman; and Frieza, the polite and terrifying tyrant. This quiz matches you with one of these eight.

Your result names your character and shows your scores for all eight. This is an unofficial fan quiz written for cv.cm. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Bird Studio, Shueisha or Toei Animation; the names belong to their owners.

faq.a: Goku, Vegeta, Gohan, Piccolo, Bulma, Krillin, Trunks and Frieza.

faq.q: Is one result rarer than the others?
faq.a: Every character appears in the same number of answers, so each one is equally likely.

faq.q: Does it cover Dragon Ball Z and Super?
faq.a: Yes. The characters come from across the series, but the questions are about personality, not story events.

goku.name: Goku
goku.body: You are cheerful, simple-hearted and always hungry, for food and for a challenge. You love to test yourself, you see the good in everyone and your energy pulls people along. Just remember the people waiting at home while you train.

vegeta.name: Vegeta
vegeta.body: You are proud, driven and fiercely competitive. You hate coming second, and that drive pushes you past your limits again and again. Nobody works harder than you when you've set your sights on something.

gohan.name: Gohan
gohan.body: You are gentle, clever and much stronger than you look. You'd rather study and spend time with family than fight, but when someone you love is threatened, your hidden power comes out. People underestimate you at their peril.

piccolo.name: Piccolo
piccolo.body: You are stern, disciplined and serious. You train in silence, you respect strength and you don't waste words. You keep your feelings to yourself, but once you give your word, you keep it.

bulma.name: Bulma
bulma.body: You are brilliant, bold and outspoken. You invent your way out of problems, you're not scared of anyone, however strong they are, and you start adventures others only dream about. The team would be lost without your brains.

krillin.name: Krillin
krillin.body: You are loyal, funny and braver than you think. You may not be the strongest in the group, but you're always there, you keep everyone's spirits up and you never stop trying. That makes you the best friend anyone could want.

trunks.name: Trunks
trunks.body: You are serious, focused and responsible. You plan ahead, you take your duties to heart and you'll do whatever it takes to protect the people who depend on you. Calm on the outside, you carry a lot; let your friends help.

frieza.name: Frieza
frieza.body: You are ambitious, composed and used to being in charge. You stay polite and cool under pressure, and you aim to be the best at everything. Your drive is impressive; just make sure you win people over rather than walk over them.
